product_overview: Single-page web application for user account registration and login for the Universidad de Medellín gym reservation system. The app supports institutional account creation and role-based sign-in using an identity document as the password.
core_goals: Create a new institutional user account with the correct role derived from the email domain
Prevent registration with non-institutional emails, duplicate emails, or invalid identity document numbers
Sign in with an existing institutional account using email and identity document
Surface clear validation and credential error feedback during registration and login

features.name: RF01 - Registro de cuenta
features.description: Lets a user create a new account using full name, institutional email, and a 10-digit identity document that also serves as the password. The backend assigns the role based on the email domain.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Switch to the registration tab -> Enter full name -> Enter a unique institutional email with the student domain -> Enter a 10-digit identity document -> Submit the registration form -> See the successful registration confirmation -> Proceed to the sign-in screen

Navigate to / -> Switch to the registration tab -> Enter full name -> Enter a Gmail address -> Enter an identity document -> Observe the non-institutional domain warning while typing -> Submit the registration form -> See the registration error message

Navigate to / -> Switch to the registration tab -> Enter full name -> Enter an already registered institutional email -> Enter a 10-digit identity document -> Submit the registration form -> See the duplicate-email registration error message

Navigate to / -> Switch to the registration tab -> Enter full name -> Enter an institutional email -> Enter fewer than 10 digits in the identity document field -> Submit the registration form -> See the identity-document validation error message

features.name: RF02 - Inicio de sesión
features.description: Lets an existing user sign in with an institutional email and identity document, then enter the application when the credentials are correct.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Stay on the sign-in tab -> Enter an institutional email that already exists -> Enter the matching identity document -> Submit the login form -> See the application home screen for the user role
Navigate to / -> Stay on the sign-in tab -> Enter a registered institutional email -> Enter an incorrect identity document -> Submit the login form -> See the invalid-credentials error message
Navigate to / -> Stay on the sign-in tab -> Enter an unregistered institutional email -> Enter any identity document -> Submit the login form -> See the invalid-credentials error message
Navigate to / -> Stay on the sign-in tab -> Leave the login fields incomplete -> Submit the login form -> See the invalid-credentials error message

routes.description: Single-page app. Shows the Login component (tabs "Iniciar sesión" / "Registrarse") when there is no session; there is no URL routing, the tab is local component state.

features.name: RF01 - Registro de cuenta
features.description: Create an account with full name, institutional email and identity document (10 digits, which is also the password). The role is derived from the email domain by the backend (RN01). Allowed domains - @soyudemedellin.edu.co (ESTUDIANTE), @udem.edu.co (ENTRENADOR), @udemedellin.edu.co (ADMIN). Any other domain (gmail, hotmail, outlook...) is rejected.
user_interactions: Fill "Correo institucional" (data-cy=registro-email); live hint appears (data-cy=registro-aviso-dominio) - "Entrarás como ESTUDIANTE" for valid domains, "Ese dominio no es institucional" otherwise
Fill "Documento de identidad" (data-cy=registro-documento, password-type input, non-digits are stripped while typing, maxLength 10)
On success the "¡Registro exitoso!" screen appears (data-cy=registro-exitoso-titulo) with button "Ir a iniciar sesión" (data-cy=registro-ir-login)
On error a red message appears (data-cy=registro-error), e.g. the backend text "Debes usar un correo institucional válido", duplicated email, or document must be exactly 10 digits

features.name: RF02 - Inicio de sesión
features.description: Log in with institutional email and identity document (the document is the password). Wrong credentials show "Correo o documento de identidad incorrectos." After 5 failed attempts for the same email the account is locked for 15 minutes, even with correct credentials.
user_interactions: On success the login screen disappears and the profile home for the role is shown
On error a red message appears (data-cy=login-error)

known_limitations.issue: Failed logins are counted per email on the server; 5 failures lock that email for 15 minutes
known_limitations.impact: Negative login tests against a real account must stay well below 5 failed attempts

known_limitations.issue: Registration writes real accounts to the shared database and the test tool cannot delete them
known_limitations.impact: Each successful registration test needs a unique email and leaves a test account behind
